protocol.selection_basis: Use the latest preselected nominal arrival with 1 s execution margin within the common 45 s deadline. Remove the existing positive progress reward rather than change execution mode; do not tune this setting after observing results. Target archived FP-AS ~40.43 s completion; 5% tolerance.
protocol.stop_condition: 600 s timeout, failed qualification or execution gate: stop without parameter/duration search; repair only evidenced implementation/config errors.

comparison_scope: One pretrial per method, matching runtime/model/physics, different geometry and method parameters. Model heights only. Arrival and completion are separate; motion-window statistics start at the first odometry speed/omega threshold crossing. No retuning based on outcome.

spatial_execution.basis: Closest segment of planned XY path during observed motion; diagnostic geometry/speed alignment, not a task-clock tracking requirement or along-track proof.
spatial_execution.clock_note: Full intentionally uses progress mode: time-domain reference error is not a timing violation. Task clock regressions are zero.

actuator_delivery.basis: Published commands replayed with original delay/tau/gain; bag receipt approximates adapter receipt; no fit, simulator only.

window_notes.historical_windows: Unchanged [task epoch,stop) metrics retained under each stop_analysis; primary comparison excludes initial stationary prefix for both methods.
window_notes.startup_difference: Full crosses motion threshold at 4.337 s versus FP-AS 1.073 s; no inserted waiting command or terminal hold. Similar task completion is not equal active-motion duration.
window_notes.tail_interpretation: Full stops translation earlier and completes goal/yaw/command draining later, leaving more modal decay before the common vehicle-completion tail window. Tail difference is not isolated input-shaping or liquid-control benefit.

validation_notes: New offline plan passed strict liquid and physical qualification.
Production C++ loading and one RTI1 native trial passed; native peak differs from Gazebo and is not substituted for it.
Native helper rebuilt only; runtime ROS binaries and generated models unchanged.
Two invalid progress-weight CLI inputs rejected before simulation startup; valid zero confirmed in live parameters.
No new Full/B0 repeats, FP-AS trials, duration search, or physical robot runs.
physical_gap: Matched nominal actuator/model; ~5 Hz real body vibration, low-speed braking variation, liquid damping/initial residual and independent liquid calibration/synchronization remain unverified.
